segments.text:
Verſ. 19.
The meeke in the Lord ſhall receiue ioy againe; and the poore men ſhall reioyce in the holie one of Iſrael.

THen the humble ſhall againe bee glad in the Lord.] I tranſlate this place thus: whereas others expound; The meeke ſhall continue to reioyce: for the Prophet ſpeakes not of the continuance of ioy, but rather of a new ioy. As if he ſhould ſay; Notwithſtanding they be heauie and ſorrowfull now, yet I will giue them cauſe of gladneſſe, that they ſhall bee once againe filled with ioy.

He ſpeakes of the humble: in which, note that we are prepared by afflctions to receiue Gods grace: for the Lord caſts vs downe and humbles vs, that hee may afterwards raiſe vs vp. When he corrects his children then, we ought not to bee diſcouraged; but rather to meditate on this and the like ſentences, and to hope ſtil aboue hope. And to cōclude, that after we haue ſuffered a little while, God will in the end giue his Church ioy and conſolation. Moreouer, we hence gather that which I touched before; to wit, that the grace of illumination is not common to all indifferently: for albeit all dranke of the ſame cuppe of affliction, yet affliction humbled but a few, to make them truely poore in ſpirit.
